[Act: prevention-of-corruption
 Chapter: Offences and Penalties
 Section: 15::Punishment for attempt.
]


Whoever attempts to commit an offence referred to in 5[clause (a)] of sub-section (1) of section 13 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term 6[which shall not be less than two years but which may extend to five years] and with fine.
